sets.relationshipLabel: an unfinished creative draft becomes a finished, releasable artistic product
sets.explanation: A sketch is refined into a completed sonata just as a rough demo is polished into a released single.

sets.relationshipLabel: an unstructured or unresolved sound quality resolves into a pleasing, defined musical quality
sets.explanation: Raw noise settles into organized music the same way clashing dissonance resolves into harmony.

sets.relationshipLabel: a single pitch-based musical unit combines with others of its kind into a larger pitch-based structure
sets.explanation: A single note strings together into a melody just as a single chord strings together into a progression.

sets.relationshipLabel: a raw physical or absent sound phenomenon becomes a specifically named musical element
sets.explanation: The physical absence of sound is notated as a rest, just as a raw vibration is heard and named as a tone.
